name: David Wohl
bio: David Wohl was born on September 22, 1953 in Brooklyn, New York, USA. He is an actor and producer, known for Revenge of the Nerds (1984), Hot Shots! Part Deux (1993) and The Wackness (2008). He has been married to Eileen McMahon since August 1978.
place: Brooklyn, New York City, New York, USA
